scope: JRN-216, JRN-217 (REQ-956..970). JRN-218 (REQ-971..975) skipped per briefing - not built.

action_items.detail: Ownership/lock of /app: no stale ownership found. No lock or ownership file exists under /app or /app/.emergent (only markers .bootstrap-complete and .restore-complete), no file contains the 'owned by the regression harness' message, and /app/e1_test_reports was writable. This run created no lock, so there was nothing to release. If the builder still sees '/app is owned by the regression harness', the refusal comes from outside the repo (its tool layer), not from anything left in /app.

At 1920x1080 the 720px widget panel renders at scale 1, but on Channels > Chat its bottom sits at y~1301, below the fold, so users must scroll to see the whole widget. The criterion is met; this is a layout polish point.
The scroll-to-latest arrow (round, radius 999px) works, but it is low-contrast against the white conversation surface (see the p18-jrn217-conversation-look scrolled-up screenshot).
No backend in this prototype (mock frontend only), so there is no backend lane. Console errors were only Vite dev-server WebSocket noise.
